tagline: Critical Role and hololive production built a canon Daggerheart campaign together. Mori Calliope's voice opens the new Made in Abyss movie this Thursday. Ratna Petit is organizing an Overwatch tournament. This week, the VTubers went full crossover.
inThisIssue: Shattered Legends — Nerissa Ravencroft, Mori Calliope, Shiori Novella, Gigi Murin, and Marisha Ray play in Exandria with Matthew Mercer at the GM seat; six-part canon series, mid-November premiere on YouTube and Beacon
Chain of the Abyss — Mori Calliope co-wrote the theme for Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery with Kevin Penkin; film premieres October 23 in Japan
NIJISANJI Extreme Match Overwatch announced October 17 — Ratna Petit and Lauren Iroas hosting; scrims October 23-24, main event October 25

lead.title: hololive production and Critical Role announce Shattered Legends — a six-part canonical Daggerheart actual play set in Exandria, with Nerissa, Calliope, Shiori, Gigi, Marisha Ray, and Matthew Mercer as GM
lead.body: Cover Corporation and Critical Role announced on October 13 that they are producing Shattered Legends, a six-part Daggerheart actual play miniseries set in Exandria, the world of all three Critical Role main campaigns. The story is canon to that setting and takes place in the Shattered Teeth region. Matthew Mercer runs the game as GM. Marisha Ray plays Florence. Four hololive English members play the remaining characters: Nerissa Ravencroft as Siliun Sil Faell, Mori Calliope as Kaz Oogod, Shiori Novella as Marchen March Rosemyne, and Gigi Murin as Giryn. Episodes air on Critical Role's YouTube channel, Nerissa Ravencroft's channel, and hololive English's channel, with Japanese subtitles for all episodes. Beacon subscribers receive a Session Zero covering character backstories and post-episode Cooldown talks. The series is sponsored by Ultra PRO; Daggerheart is published by Darrington Press. The mid-November premiere date is not yet specific. This is the first time Critical Role has produced an official collaboration directly with a VTuber agency. For hololive, it is the first time its talent has appeared in a production that is canonically part of another franchise's existing shared world rather than an original hololive story. Coverage spread immediately from VTuber-native media to tabletop RPG outlets including Wargamer, Tubefilter, and Siliconera, each framing it as an unusual crossover. The audience math is not complicated: Critical Role's community is global, streaming-adjacent, and table-game-native; hololive English's community is global, streaming-adjacent, and anime-adjacent. Shattered Legends puts both in the same room with the same GM. The actual play genre has not had a production quite like this. Calliope's character is named Kaz Oogod. This is real and it premieres in November.

stories.title: Chain of the Abyss — Mori Calliope and Kevin Penkin wrote the Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery theme; film opens in Japan this Thursday, October 23
stories.blurb: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery, Part 1 of a new theatrical film series for the franchise, opens in Japan on October 23. The theme song is Chain of the Abyss, co-written and performed by Mori Calliope with composer Kevin Penkin. Calliope stated that the Made in Abyss series has been personally important to her since before her debut, and that she is grateful to Penkin for the collaboration opportunity. Kinema Citrus returns as the production studio. The film follows Riko, Reg, Nanachi, and Faputa from the point where Dawn of the Deep Soul concluded. The theme was first previewed in the main trailer in August; Calliope's formal announcement confirmed vocals and partial lyric credits. Chain of the Abyss is her first theatrical film theme credit. The film opens in four days.

stories.title: NIJISANJI Extreme Match Overwatch announced October 17 — Ratna Petit and Lauren Iroas organizing; scrims October 23-24, main tournament October 25 on NIJISANJI YouTube
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI Extreme Match returns with its second edition, this time using Overwatch; the first edition used VALORANT. Ratna Petit and Lauren Iroas are organizing. The October 17 announcement stream revealed the format, teams, and coaches. Blizzard supplied participant team skins. Scrims run October 23 and 24; the main tournament broadcasts at 15:00 JST on October 25 on NIJISANJI's official YouTube channel. The October 25 slot puts the Extreme Match on the same calendar day as the Phase Saga one-year anniversary, making it the second-largest simultaneous VTuber event on that date. Full bracket and schedule details at streampalooza.jp.

stories.title: Phase Saga one-year anniversary is six days away — the pre-debut quiet-period math resolves this week, and Phase Connect has not announced anything
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's Phase Saga generation — Clio Aite, Mari Mari, Eepy Sleepy — marks one year on October 25. As of this issue that is six days away. The community pre-debut behavioral tracker's third indicator is an approximately eleven-day account quiet period before a Phase Connect debut announcement; if it started October 13 as the community math requires for an October 24 resolution, today is day seven of eleven. Phase Connect has posted nothing tied to the anniversary. @Filian_VT1 remains DEBUT DELAYED. The prediction either resolves this week or it does not. Six days.

stories.title: IZIGENIA debuts four new members October 17-19 — B.B.-MuaMua, Veilvet Whitmore, Nyra Nightclaw, and Elvara Throne Rozalia join ClaN Entertainment's global VTuber project
stories.blurb: ClaN Entertainment's IZIGENIA global VTuber project launched four new members across October 17-19. B.B.-MuaMua opened, followed by Veilvet Whitmore, Nyra Nightclaw, and Elvara Throne Rozalia in staggered slots. The project launched in May 2026 with Ruridori Kafka and Sedric Alfiere, expanded in July with DubsteP, and this wave brings the roster to nine-plus members. IZIGENIA's fiction is a science-fiction setting where two factions, the Outriders and the Aliens, contest over desire and evolution. Activity runs on YouTube and Twitch with a multinational, English-primary debut format. The project is one of the few agency-backed global VTuber projects with an explicit sci-fi lore backbone that has sustained a regular debut cadence across 2026.

stories.title: NIJISANJI x Hokaron limited-voice hand warmers — four livers' exclusive voices bundled with the autumn-winter seasonal collab product
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI and Hokaron launched a limited seasonal collaboration featuring exclusive voice packs from four NIJISANJI livers bundled with the hand warmer product. The collaboration runs as part of Hokaron's autumn-winter campaign. The bundle deploys the voice pack strategy into seasonal retail rather than digital-only sale, continuing the broader NIJISANJI merchandise push through Q4 alongside Secret Favor Voice, which remains on sale through October 31. Four livers' voices attached to a physical warming product is a distinctive format in the agency's collab catalog. Details and participating livers at collabo-cafe.com.

indies.title: October Q4 indie debut class enters week 2 — Ome Teoru and Nibbelle launched October 10-11; Namirisu and CapoCoda scheduled for October 26 and 29
indies.blurb: The October indie debut class moved into its second week as the K-Arena calendar cleared. Ome Teoru launched October 10 and Nibbelle on October 11, debuting on the same days as MECHATU-A at Yokohama. Namirisu is scheduled for October 26 and CapoCoda for October 29, extending the cohort across the final week of the month. The Phase Saga anniversary on October 25 and the NIJISANJI Extreme Match on the same day concentrate agency-side viewer attention for the second consecutive week. October indie launches are competing for first-stream audience against the densest agency event calendar of the year. Cohort tracking at hololist.net.

tea.text: The /vt/ Shattered Legends reaction thread split into three camps within six hours of the announcement. The first — hololive fans who had never heard of Critical Role — discovered that Calliope's character is named Kaz Oogod and debated whether this is the best or worst character name in the campaign. The thread concluded it is both. The second camp — Critical Role fans who had never encountered hololive — arrived three hours later and were informed that the pink one does rap-metal and the owl one has a lore document with footnotes. The third camp — people who are already fans of both — posted I've been waiting for this and received the immediate reply no you haven't, you made that up just now, you found out at the same time as everyone else. All three camps are watching in November. Kaz Oogod. That's the character name. That's canon to Exandria now.

The Filian quiet-period probability thread hit its highest single-week view count on October 14. The math: if the third pre-debut behavioral indicator started October 13, today (October 19) is day seven of eleven, and October 24 is the resolution date — one day before the Phase Saga anniversary on October 25. The tracker's exact post: I am not predicting October 24. I am saying that if the pattern held and the quiet period started the day the math requires, it resolves to October 24, and Phase Connect has the Phase Saga anniversary one day later, and the narrative geometry of this is the funniest thing I've seen in two years of tracking debuts. The post received 1,500 upvotes. Phase Connect has not said anything. Today is October 19.

The NIJISANJI Extreme Match Overwatch announcement thread spent its first 48 hours writing taxonomies of participants by likely tournament outcome and a parallel set organized around a different question entirely. Ratna Petit is listed as organizer and also as a participant with ambiguous status; the thread spent considerable energy on whether organizing and playing in the same tournament is unprecedented, conventional, or simply ratna-coded. The Overwatch community discovering the event on October 17 contributed two reactions in sequence: I did not know NIJISANJI ran competitive Overwatch, followed immediately by they don't, it's a tournament, they're learning. The thread is taking this as the correct framing and has appended it to the official event title in their logs. The bracket is speculated. The coaching notes are real. October 25.

The Made in Abyss fandom discovered Mori Calliope this week as the October 23 premiere approached. The pattern is identical to the OdeHolo and Shattered Legends coverage: a major announcement reaching an adjacent community that had not previously tracked VTubers. /vt/ threads monitoring the made-in-abyss side of social media reported the discovery in real time — they found the Chain of the Abyss theme credit, clicked the name, and arrived at a VTuber with a death-rap discography. One made-in-abyss subreddit post calling it the best franchise theme since Interference trended briefly. The /vt/ thread cited this without comment except for one reply: she's been doing this since 2020, which felt like not enough information to the person who received it.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 26 October — by then Suisei will have played Kobe, Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery will be in Japanese theaters, the Phase Saga anniversary will be one day in the past, and the NIJISANJI Extreme Match will have a winner. See you in seven.
